_policy: Pre-registered targets for the Q3 key rework (#2079), frozen BEFORE any DSP change lands. Modeled on the predict/drop frozen.json discipline: numbers move or the change reverts. Profile/constant selection reads the TUNE half only; the holdout half is scored once, at the end of the round. Split rule: int(sha256(track_id),16) % 2 == 0 -> tune (canonical: analyze_predict_drop.py is_tune). chosen_config stays null until the final report-card commit.

targets.no_estimate_rate: <= 0.05 (profile swap moves the correlation scale vs the 0.3 emit gate)
targets.guard_datasets: harmonix beat-F/downbeat-F/tempo-acc1 + structure pairwise/boundary, ballroom beat-F, giantsteps_tempo acc1 each within 0.02 of the #2077 report card, or the regression is stated and explicitly accepted with rationale

iteration_cmd: bench/run_bench.py bench/datasets/giantsteps_key --jobs 4 --out-root bench/out/q-iter $(python3 -c "import json; print(' '.join('--only '+t for t in json.load(open('bench/manifests/dev_subset.json'))['tracks']['giantsteps_key']))")

chosen_config._selected_on: tune half only, via bench/sweep_key.py replay over production e61 sidecars (fidelity 46/48 vs real bench); holdout scored once at round end (binary 38a932cb, 2026-08-10)

front_end.key_fold: pure fold, no harmonic template, unnormalized, floored at MIDI 54
front_end.bass_tracker: 32-183 Hz log-QIFFT dominant peak, 0.35 st cents gate, 3-hop persistence, W_BASS 1.0

detector.profiles: braw (Faraldo Beatport median profiles, Essentia key.cpp; corpus disjoint from the 604-track test set per Faraldo 2016)

rejected_with_evidence.edmm: tune .5135 but major_recall 0.0 — disqualified by the pre-registered floor
rejected_with_evidence.mode_contrast_override: hurts at every margin on the full config (best .5513 vs .5524 baseline); bass deposit already carries the mode information

targets_verdict.holdout_weighted_score: MISSED by 0.0052 (.4948 vs >= .5) — stated, not excused; remaining lever is the learned profile (Q6)
targets_verdict.tune_minus_holdout: MISSED by 0.0065 (.0565 vs <= .05) — stated; profile+constants were tune-selected, gap is real
targets_verdict.major_mode_recall: PASS on the full run (.4194 vs >= .4); holdout alone reads .3774
targets_verdict.fixture: PASS at every commit; key floor ratcheted .3 -> .9
targets_verdict.guard_datasets: PASS — ballroom/giantsteps_tempo/harmonix beat/downbeat/tempo/structure all match the #2077 report card to rounding
